Milky Way disc center — the Sun sits at the scene origin and its true 26 700-ly galactocentric distance lands the disc center 267 units down −X (the sfGalacticVec axis map puts l=0 at −X), so the solar system renders embedded inside the disc at its real half-radius ring instead of floating beside a face-on photo.
